title: Nothing reaches a Dormant card
notes: The fuzz monitor's new I19 fails any step in which something reaches a Dormant card, and its 1,000-seed waves found four engine paths that did: the Fuse verb (fuseCards) now passes a Dormant ingredient or target by, as a Transform does (R4454003; Core #85 Unlicensed Experimentation fused onto a Dormant Starship); the Brittle tick and the Burn and Toxic ticks pass a Dormant card by, its counts waiting until it awakens (R4454004); and the state check's switch out of Defense Position passes a Dormant card by until it awakens (R4454005). The cards claimed are those classify's forced games found playing differently.

player.title: Dormant cards stay out of reach
fixes: Unlicensed Experimentation and every other Fuse no longer fuse onto a Dormant card or fuse one away.
A Dormant card's Brittle, Burn and Toxic no longer tick while it sleeps; they pick up where they left off once it wakes.
A Dormant card in Defense Position is no longer switched to Attack Position while it sleeps.
